brief.en: All six ground-floor halls are validated and are being merged into one ground-floor model (validation due 27 Nov). The live BMS API and Level 1 data are both due 20 Nov; upper-floor data is about a month late. The best AI result so far is about 8% total energy saving, and the baseline must be agreed from historical data before any on-site trial.
brief.zh: 一层 6 个机房均已验证,正合并为一层整体模型(11 月 27 日完成验证)。实时 BMS API 与 Level 1 数据均定于 11 月 20 日;上层楼层数据约晚一个月。目前 AI 最佳结果约 8% 总节能,现场试运行前须先基于历史数据确定节能基线。

reco.en: Close out 02 (live BMS API, 20 Nov) and 03 (Level 1 data, 20 Nov): 32 edge ingestion, 13 closed-loop control and the upper-floor twins all wait on them. In parallel, agree the 31 baseline with DayOne before any trial.

CHANGELOG.text: Best AI result so far is about 8% total energy saving (5% from running 2 of 3 chillers in Plants A and C, 3% from optimised setpoints); the baseline will be fixed from historical data before any on-site trial (source: Project implement 1116).

Data for all six ground-floor halls (E-GA to E-GF) and chiller plants A+B received. Per-hall AI training dropped for one holistic ground-floor model; 04 Digital Twin Framework ground-floor validation targeted 27 Nov, Level 1 data due 20 Nov (source: DayOne Weekly Meeting).

03 Historical BMS Data batch-retrieval templates tested and working. E-GA AI policy saves about 30% fan power with no SLA breach; DayOne confirmed the third chiller per plant is redundancy, not load (source: DayOne Weekly Meeting).
Site visit findings: about 3.5 m conductive false ceiling with a 2 °C drop to the return; floor 1A hot aisle is 53U, not 45U. Chiller plant A/B data uploaded (source: DayOne Weekly Meeting).

GA to GF historical data received; GD and GE twins validated. Ground-floor SLA confirmed at 23 °C (24 °C upper floors). BMS is read-only and fan-speed writability is unconfirmed (source: DayOne Weekly Meeting).
Multi-zone calibration reached 0.28 °C mean error over Jan–Jun, down from about 3 °C on the first run; site visit set for 28 Oct (source: DayOne Weekly Meeting).
GA and GB digital twins validated; chiller system A data complete; GC data still being checked (source: DayOne Weekly Meeting).

GB validation only partial (GB1 has power readings only). Simulation under-predicts about 0.25 °C at 28–30 °C, so the AI applies a safety buffer; one agent per hall plus one per chiller plant agreed (source: DayOne Weekly Meeting).
05 Single Data Hall Pilot: first hall (GA) digital twin fully validated. NTP-E API still unconfirmed by the vendor, so connect to NDP first (source: DayOne Weekly Meeting).
Cold-aisle validation: RMSE 0.05 °C on average, about 0.1 °C per aisle; per-sensor safety buffers based on RMSE agreed (source: DayOne Weekly Meeting).
Reduced-order thermal model built for the first data hall; return-air control kept for now, direct fan-speed override to be revisited (source: DayOne Weekly Meeting).
03 Historical BMS Data missed its original 08/14 target date; latest forecast has slipped to 08/21 (source: DayOne Weekly Meeting).
Confirmed rollout path: Recommendation → Human Monitoring / Validation → Auto-Control (source: Digital Twin Sharing Session).

MEETINGS.title: Project implement (RDA internal)
MEETINGS.summary: Three models being merged into one; best result about 8% energy saving (5% chiller, 3% setpoints) across about ten trained strategies, with fewer hotspot hours. Baseline to be agreed from historical data before customer trials; a manual test plan for fan speed, chilled-water and condenser-water setpoints to go to Justin.

MEETINGS.title: DayOne Weekly Meeting
MEETINGS.summary: All six ground-floor halls and chiller plants A+B received and validated per hall; switch to a holistic ground-floor model, validation by 27 Nov. E-GA AI saves 30.9% fan energy with no hours outside 18–23 °C. Level 1 data and live BMS API both targeted 20 Nov; condenser-water step test proposed; COV data flagged as a robustness risk.

MEETINGS.title: DayOne Weekly Meeting
MEETINGS.summary: Batch data-retrieval templates work; live BMS API 1–2 weeks out. Ground-floor validation complete; E-GA AI cuts fan power about 30% within the 23 °C limit. BI shows 3 chillers per plant where 2 suffice; scenario list for fan-speed experiments to go to Justin.

MEETINGS.title: DayOne Weekly Meeting
MEETINGS.summary: Site visit: conductive false ceiling at about 3.5 m with a 2 °C drop, hot aisle 53U in floor 1A, CRAH logic clarified. Chiller plant A/B data uploaded; real-time API comes from the Edge agent and will be trialled jointly once DayOne trusts the BMS data.

MEETINGS.title: DayOne Weekly Meeting
MEETINGS.summary: GA–GF historical data in; GD/GE twins validated, GF next. Twin over-predicts about 0.5 °C (safe side). AI on GD/GE settles fans near 52% for about 38% air-side saving; BMS is read-only, so fan-speed writability must be confirmed before tests.

MEETINGS.title: DayOne Weekly Meeting
MEETINGS.summary: GD and GE data received, GF best effort. Multi-zone model calibrated to 0.28 °C mean error over six months; site visit to Data Hall 1G set for 28 Oct; API still waiting on the vendor.

MEETINGS.title: DayOne Weekly Meeting
MEETINGS.summary: GA and GB twins trained and validated; Mingchen explained how fan speed and supply-air setpoints save energy while holding heat balance. Chiller system A data complete; GC data to be double-checked.

MEETINGS.title: DayOne Weekly Meeting
MEETINGS.summary: Partial GB validation because GB1 lacks unit-level data. Hot aisle matches on trend; power matches the fan affinity law. Multi-agent AI design (one per hall, one per chiller plant) with human-in-the-loop recommendations; first GA training results next week.

MEETINGS.title: DayOne Weekly Meeting
MEETINGS.summary: First hall (GA) digital twin fully validated; halls differ in temperature spread and valve response, GC shows an unexplained heat source. AI training starts on GA with safety as the binding constraint; DayOne wants full GA/GB/GC data before scenario runs.

MEETINGS.title: DayOne Weekly Meeting
MEETINGS.summary: Cold-aisle validation RMSE 0.05 °C average; per-sensor buffers from RMSE agreed. System A data-hall data prioritised over the chiller plant; PDU-to-aisle mapping clarified for the BI tool.

MEETINGS.title: DayOne Weekly Meeting
MEETINGS.summary: Reduced-order thermal model built for the first hall; temperature patterns show local cold-air stagnation rather than a hall-wide issue. Return-air control kept for now; fan-speed override capability to be confirmed.

MEETINGS.title: DayOne Weekly Meeting
MEETINGS.summary: One-Data-Hall historical extraction, TH sensor mapping, and the historical-data insight run are all confirmed done on schedule; Data Point/API alignment continues with its target pushed to 08/28; the Single Data Hall Pilot now moves into validation using the delivered data; cold-aisle thermal analysis shows a healthy SLA margin plus a CRAH setpoint-tuning opportunity to investigate.

MEETINGS.title: DayOne Weekly Meeting
MEETINGS.summary: Digital Twin calibration takes priority over AI control; historical data can be provided in batches; BMS/PMS API and control points still to be aligned

MEETINGS.title: Digital Twin Sharing Session
MEETINGS.summary: Cooling topology, BMS data sharing, and the calibration path: Recommendation → Human Monitoring → Auto-Control
